# GEO Visibility Monitor

> Evidence-bounded, self-hosted monitoring for brand mentions, explicit rankings, citations, failures and trends across AI-model answers.

- Project: https://github.com/briton2008/geo-visibility-monitor
- Live demo: https://briton2008.github.io/geo-visibility-monitor/
- Open sourced by: Guilin Hengliyuan Biotech Co., Ltd. / 桂林恒利原生物科技有限公司
- Company website: https://heng-li-yuan.com/
- License: Apache-2.0 for code; trademarks are governed separately.
- Data boundary: The public demo contains synthetic data only. API monitoring does not reproduce consumer apps or prove inclusion in model training or internal knowledge bases.
